issue.content:
name: 🏗️ Architecture proposal
description: Propose and validate one change to the LLM architecture.
title: "[ARCH-PROP] "
labels:
  - architecture proposal
  - under review

body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        # Architecture proposal

        Use this form to propose one architecture change. Keep the proposal focused and submit unrelated changes separately.
        
  - type: input
    id: proposal_name
    attributes:
      label: Architecture Name
      description: Provide a short, descriptive name for the proposed architecture or modification.
      placeholder: "Example: OLMo3"
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        > [!IMPORTANT]
        > Select the parent from the
        > [Existing Architecture Proposals](https://feanus.github.io/archspace/web).
        > 
        > - Enter the parent Issue number in the format `#123`.
        > - Enter `None` only when proposing a root architecture.
    
  - type: input
    id: base_architecture_issue
    attributes:
      label: Parent issue
      description: Enter an Architecture Proposal issue number such as `#123`, or `None` for the root architecture.
      placeholder: "Example: #123 or None"
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: problem_and_hypothesis
    attributes:
      label: Motivations
      description: Explain the problem and why it matters, identify the limitation or gap in the base architecture, and state the hypothesis or insight motivating this proposal.
      placeholder: Describe the problem, its significance, the architectural gap, and the hypothesis behind this proposal.
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: proposed_change
    attributes:
      label: Proposed Architecture
      description: Describe the proposed architecture and how it differs from the base architecture. Specify what changes and the expected impact.
      placeholder: Define the architecture change, its relationship to the base architecture.
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: existing_results
    attributes:
      label: Preliminary Results (if any)
      description: Summarize relevant prior work and any existing experiments, prototypes, analyses, or observations that support or challenge the proposal.
      placeholder: Cite related work(s) and summarize any available evidence, experimental results, comparisons, and limitations.
    validations:
      required: false

  - type: textarea
    id: validation_plan
    attributes:
      label: Experiments Plan
      description: Define how the proposal will be evaluated, including research questions, baselines, datasets or tasks, metrics, ablations, and evaluation protocol. Specify measurable success criteria and compute or data requirements.
      placeholder: Describe the experiments, comparisons, metrics, ablations, success criteria, and required resources.
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        ---

        Maintainers review the proposal before implementation starts:

        - `under review`: waiting for a maintainer decision
        - `in-progress`: approved for implementation
        - `declined`: rejected or deferred; the Issue is closed
        - `verified`: a linked implementation PR was merged; the Issue is closed

        Status labels are mutually exclusive and maintained by repository automation.
